url.description: Canonical detail URL of the listing

country.description: Source country code (ro, pl, bg, pt, ua, kz)

title.description: Raw listing title as entered by the seller (free-form)

description.description: Listing description with HTML tags stripped; may contain equipment notes, contact info, or condition details

price.description: Seller-listed price amount; null if price not disclosed

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the listed price (e.g. EUR, PLN, UAH)

priceNegotiable.description: True when the seller accepts negotiations (price.type == arranged)

pricePrevious.description: Previous price before a seller-initiated reduction; null if no price change

priceConverted.description: Price converted to the local currency when seller listed in a foreign currency; null if no conversion

priceCurrencyConverted.description: Currency code of priceConverted; null if no conversion

make.description: Car brand/make resolved from the OLX brand-level category (e.g. BMW, Volkswagen)

model.description: Car model from listing params (locale-specific label, e.g. X6, Seria 5)

mileageKm.description: Odometer reading normalised to kilometres (UA mileage-in-thousands is multiplied by 1000)

fuelType.description: Normalised fuel type: petrol, diesel, electric, hybrid, lpg, or other

transmission.description: Normalised transmission type: manual, automatic, semi-automatic, or other

bodyType.description: Normalised body style: sedan, suv, hatchback, estate, coupe, convertible, pickup, mpv, or other

condition.description: Normalised listing condition: used, new, or damaged

engineCapacityCm3.description: Engine displacement in cm³ (UA litre values are multiplied by 1000)

powerHp.description: Engine power in horsepower/HP (CP/KM/CV units are all treated as equivalent)

color.description: Exterior colour as an English slug (e.g. black, white, silver); UA/KZ numeric IDs are resolved via a lookup table

vin.description: VIN number when disclosed by the seller (available on PL via vin, UA via vin_number, BG via vinnomer)

licensePlate.description: Partially masked licence plate number (PT and UA only)

drivetrain.description: Drive type raw slug (PL drive, UA drive_type); null for RO/BG/PT/KZ which do not expose this field

steeringWheelSide.description: Steering wheel position: lhd or rhd (RO and PL only)

doorCount.description: Number of doors (RO door_count, BG doors, UA doors_num); null for PL/PT/KZ

seatCount.description: Number of seats (PT nr_seats, BG seats, UA seats_num); null for RO/PL/KZ

registrationStatus.description: Registration status: registered or unregistered (RO only)

countryOfOrigin.description: Country from which the car was imported (PL country_origin, PT origin, BG import field)

customsCleared.description: Whether customs duties have been paid: yes or no (UA cleared_customs field only)

ownersCount.description: Number of previous owners (KZ owners field only)

co2Emissions.description: CO2 emissions in g/km (PT co2_emissions field only)

features.description: Equipment and feature keys merged from UA/KZ car_option checklist and BG comfort/multimedia/safety/other checklists. Empty array for countries that do not expose a structured feature list (RO, PL, PT).

images.description: Photo URLs at 800x600 resolution from the OLX CDN (frankfurt.apollo.olxcdn.com)

promotionFlags.description: Paid promotion status from the listing's promotion field

highlighted.description: Whether the listing is highlighted (paid feature)

topAd.description: Whether the listing is a top ad (paid feature)

urgent.description: Whether the listing is marked urgent (paid feature)

postedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the listing was first posted (created_time)

refreshedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last seller-triggered bump (last_refresh_time)

validTo.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the listing expires (valid_to_time)

scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was scraped

changeType.description: Change lifecycle status relative to the previous run's snapshot. Values: NEW (first time seen), UPDATED (one of 5 tracked fields changed), UNCHANGED (identical to snapshot), REAPPEARED (was MISSING in prior run; back in results), MISSING (was in snapshot; absent from current results). Only present when incrementalMode is true.

firstSeenAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this listing was first observed (changeType: NEW). Immutable after initial set. Only present when incrementalMode is true.

lastSeenAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this listing was last observed in results. Updated on every run where the listing is present (including UNCHANGED and UPDATED). Not updated for MISSING items. Only present when incrementalMode is true.

priceHistory.description: Price history for this offer (incrementalMode only). Each entry records the price and currency at the time of a change. Entries are appended only when price or currency changes; unchanged runs do not add entries. Capped at 50 entries (oldest removed first).

seenAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this price was observed

price.description: Seller-listed price at this observation; null if undisclosed

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the price at this observation

isRepost.description: True when this offer reappeared after being absent from at least one prior run (changeType == REAPPEARED). False for NEW, UPDATED, UNCHANGED, and MISSING items. Only present when incrementalMode is true.

paramsRaw.description: Full raw params array from the OLX API offer object. Pass-through for country-specific fields not surfaced by the normalised schema. Always present (empty array when params absent).

uuid.description: Opaque seller UUID for cross-listing deduplication

name.description: Display name (first name for private sellers)

companyName.description: Dealer company name; null for private sellers

hasPhone.description: Whether the seller accepts phone contact (contact.phone bool). Actual phone number is not extracted.

hasChat.description: Whether OLX in-app chat is enabled for this seller

district.description: District name (present for PL and UA; absent for other countries)

latitude.description: Approximate GPS latitude; may be obfuscated to neighbourhood centroid when gpsObfuscated is true

longitude.description: Approximate GPS longitude; may be obfuscated to neighbourhood centroid when gpsObfuscated is true

gpsObfuscated.description: True when map.show_detailed is false, meaning coordinates are snapped to a neighbourhood centroid rather than the exact address

listings.title: Car Listings
listings.description: All scraped car listings with key details
